1.

A humble, patient servant Came, the Lord of all lords, To save the lost, The great and the small; And at His departure He gave Us this testament: Brethren, serve one another, As I served you all.

2.

Thy people, O Lord, with Thy blood Were redeemed to preserve, In purity, In humility and patience, The unity of the Spirit. One Lord and one faith, one baptism Offered the same comfort to all, Who yield to the call of grace To Thine arms.

3.

We are members in one body, Needing one another, And each has received a commission To walk in Thy love. A service Thou gavest to each, Who here have known Thy grace, May we in faith fulfill it; How richly wilt Thou not reward.

4.

Help us to administer our pound here, As Thy words bid us. Our Master, Thou art gracious, Thy voice shall soon be heard: My servant shall have rest In the heights of glory, Enter into the joy of thy Lord, And share the joys of heaven!
